title: Converse tool-use loop with a guardrail, tenant-safe tools and cost logging
scenario: Tidewater Ask's support assistant moves from a notebook calling InvokeModel to the Bedrock Converse API with two DynamoDB-backed tools, a guardrail and the per-turn token and cost numbers FinOps asked for. Security review rule: tools take the tenant from the verified token, never from the model.
task: Build a Converse request with toolConfig, system prompt, maxTokens and guardrailConfig
Run the tool-use loop: parallel toolUse blocks, one user message of toolResults, error results
Handle guardrail_intervened, max_tokens and a tool-round limit
Sum usage across rounds, estimate cost, log one JSON line per model call
acceptance: Requests pass botocore validation against the real Converse model (Stubber)
A forged tenant_id tool argument cannot read or write another tenant's data
Outcomes, usage, cost and logs correct across multi-round turns

practices.label: Week 1 Tue - tool use on Bedrock
Week 1 Thu - tokens, cost, invocation logging
